requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BM in Organ Performance and Sacred Music requires a minimum of 120 credits. Requirements follow the 2024-2025 Silent Advisor; SMTD students follow the curriculum of their admit year.

requirements.label: Non-Music credits (30)
requirements.hint: At least 30 credits outside music. Courses within Arts Administration, Dance, and Theatre also count as non-Music.

requirements.label: Music Theory core (Aural and Written Skills I-IV)
requirements.hint: THEORY 139, 149, 140, 150, 239, 249, 240, and 250. The aural and written skills sequences run across the first two years. JAZZ 220 can be taken in place of THEORY 239 and 249, and JAZZ 221 in place of THEORY 240 and 250 (use an override if you substitute).

requirements.label: 400 level Theory electives (6 credits)
requirements.hint: Two 400 level Theory electives, 6 credits total: the Silent Advisor lists one 400 level Theory elective plus an additional 400 level Theory course.

requirements.label: Musicology core
requirements.hint: MUSICOL 139 Intro to the Study of Music, 140 History of U.S. Musics, 239 History of Music, and 240 History of Western Music.

requirements.label: 400 level Musicology, Theory, or listed Jazz elective (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One 400 level Musicology or Theory elective, or JAZZ 460, 467, 470, or 479.

requirements.label: Ensembles (2 terms from the approved list)
requirements.hint: Two terms from the listed ensembles.

requirements.label: Additional approved ensembles (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two additional terms of any approved ensemble beyond the two listed-ensemble terms.

requirements.label: Organ performance lessons (24 credits)
requirements.hint: Minimum 24 credits of organ lessons with completion of ORGAN 440. Piano study as recommended by the department. Extensive repertory requirements (baroque through 21st century) are tracked by the organ studio.

requirements.label: Conducting (CONDUCT 315 and 316)
requirements.hint: CONDUCT 315 Elementary Conducting I and CONDUCT 316 Elementary Conducting II.

requirements.label: Sacred music and organ literature
requirements.hint: ORGANLIT 481 Organ Literature Pre-1750, ORGANLIT 482 Organ Literature 1750 to Present, SACREDMU 483 Improvisation I, SACREDMU 484 Service Playing, SACREDMU 490 Improvisation II, and SACREDMU 491 Creative Hymn-Playing.

requirements.label: Early Music 450: Basso Continuo
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. Early Music 450 Basso Continuo, 2 credits, normally in the fall of third year; the course catalog does not currently carry this code, so mark it met with an override once taken.

requirements.label: MUSPERF 440: Senior Recital
requirements.hint: Zero credit capstone recital in the final year, taken alongside ORGAN 440. Works performed for the degree recital are to be memorized, except ensemble works and works in challenging contemporary idioms.

requirements.label: Language: French, German, or Spanish (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of French, German, or Spanish.

requirements.label: French (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of French.

requirements.label: German (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of German.

requirements.label: Spanish (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of Spanish.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 124, 125, or an equivalent first year writing course.

requirements.label: Upper level writing
requirements.hint: An upper level writing course approved by the Sweetland Writing Center.

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity course
requirements.hint: One course in Race and Ethnicity selected from approved courses within LSA, or within SMTD by petition. SMTD RE courses will not count into overall non-SMTD credits.
